text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O and I are training outside,
when...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me... You're T.M. Opera O, aren't
you? I'm
a huge fan!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Well, now! You must have an eye for
aesthetics!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I shall reward it with a special copy of
my new
headshot I took just yesterday.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Not a single one! Where could they have
all
gone?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, what have I done?! That was the
entire
stock?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I'm terribly sorry. Please, would you
accept my
autograph for now?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The fan looks overjoyed to get an
autograph, but
Opera O is in utter
despair.
